context_docs.text: Apples are red, green, or yellow fruits that grow on trees in temperate climates. They are high in fiber and vitamin C. The original wild ancestor, Malus sieversii, originated in Central Asia. Apples are members of the Rosaceae family. The apple tree was brought to North America by European colonists. Apple varieties include Gala, Fuji, Granny Smith, Honeycrisp, and Red Delicious. Each variety has slightly different nutritional content. Please note that apples are also commonly used in desserts such as apple pie. They are also fermented to produce cider. The phrase 'an apple a day keeps the doctor away' is a well-known proverb. The proverb is of medieval origin. Apples contain antioxidants. Apples are also used in baking.

Bananas are elongated yellow tropical fruits produced by several kinds of large herbaceous plants. They are rich in potassium. Bananas are also a good source of vitamin B6. Please note that bananas grow in bunches. The banana plant is actually not a tree but an herb. The largest producers of bananas are India and China. Bananas are also used in cooking, including banana bread. There are many varieties of banana, including the Cavendish, which is the most common. Bananas are also used in smoothies. They can be dried and eaten as a snack. The phrase 'go bananas' is a common English idiom.

Oranges are round citrus fruits high in vitamin C. The orange originated in Southeast Asia and was spread worldwide. Oranges are also rich in folate. The most common variety is the Valencia orange. Navel oranges are seedless. Blood oranges have red flesh. Please note that orange juice is a popular breakfast beverage. Oranges are also used in marmalade. The orange blossom is the state flower of Florida. Oranges are also used in essential oils. They are often grown in Mediterranean climates.

Mangoes are drupe fruits from the Mangifera indica tree, native to South Asia. They are rich in vitamins A and C. Please also note that mangoes come in many varieties including Alphonso, Keitt, and Tommy Atkins. Mangoes are used widely in chutneys and pickles. India is the largest producer of mangoes. The mango is the national fruit of India. Mangoes are also used in smoothies. They are eaten both ripe and unripe. Unripe mangoes are used in dishes like mango salad.

Botanically, a fruit is the mature ovary of a flowering plant, usually containing seeds.
And how do I pick a ripe one?
Look for bright color, slight give when pressed, and a fragrant aroma at the stem end.
Most fruit keeps best refrigerated; bananas and tomatoes are exceptions and should be kept at room temperature.
